api: REST API returning answers with source citations.
cons: A citation does not always support the claim attached to it
Weaker than dedicated assistants at writing and reasoning
Source quality varies with what ranks well
name: Perplexity AI
pros: Genuinely current, unlike static model knowledge
files: Accepts document uploads on paid tiers, with web retrieval as the primary input.
value: Answers questions with inline citations to the sources used, which makes it materially more checkable than a general assistant. The right tool when the answer needs to be traced back rather than merely produced.
engine: Model-agnostic, routing to frontier models from several vendors, layered over its own retrieval and ranking.

pricing.includes: Advanced model choice, file upload, higher limits
SSO, admin controls, data retention controls

quality: Citations are the differentiator and the caveat. They make verification possible, but a citation is not a guarantee: the tool sometimes cites a source that does not fully support the sentence. Read the source, do not trust the footnote.
tagline: Search rebuilt as a citing answer engine rather than a list of links.
use_cases: Fast market and competitor research with sources attached
Checking a current fact where a general model's knowledge would be stale
First-pass literature and regulatory scanning before deeper verification
governance_note: For an audit or compliance workflow, treat its citations exactly as this site treats news: a lead to the primary source, never the evidence itself.
training_optout: Enterprise tiers offer data controls and an AI training opt-out. Consumer tiers differ. Verify before regulated research goes through it.
